extraction.notes: Column used: three months ended December 31, 2023. Real estate impairment is zero for Q4 2023 (the $41,860 impairment was in Q3 2023) and is omitted. Loss on extinguishment of debt, structuring expenses, transformation costs and non-cash loss on extinguishment are zero in Q4 2023 and omitted. Reconciliation FFO-to-Core FFO and FFO-to-AFFO both checked: 20,990 - 108 = 20,882; 20,990 - 459 = 20,531. Core FFO per share 20,882/87,836 = 0.24, NAREIT FFO per share 20,990/87,836 = 0.24, consistent with reported. The company also reports Core AFFO of $20,345 (Q4 2023), which is built from AFFO by adding back severance, relocation, pursuit write-offs and deferred tax adjustment; that line is not captured in the AFFO total since the schema takes the AFFO subtotal (Core AFFO was not recorded). Relocation expense (3) and Adjustment to deferred taxes (526) were classed as 'other' since no listed category fits. 'Non-real estate depreciation and amortization of debt costs' (1,217) was classed as debt_cost_amortization; the label mixes non-real-estate D&A and debt-cost amortization. Amortization of lease intangibles (248) classed as 'other'. The AFFO table's first line is NAREIT FFO (20,990) which ties to the reconciliation. Company does not disclose AFFO per share for Q4; the AFFO recurring capital improvements line is present, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
